name: Pipeliners - Blog - Monsoon Pillar Refresh
body:
> Blog · Pipeliners · 2026-07-20

# Summary
An in-place refresh of the live pillar /monsoon-season-pipe-problems/ (post 15609, published Jul 6) instead of a new August page on the same intent ("Why Sewer Backups Can Get Worse During Arizona Monsoon Season").

# Changes in the file
1. New section on how a plumber diagnoses a monsoon sewer problem (camera; clog vs crack, collapse, roots or belly), linking the cracked vs collapsed post and the Mesa camera guide.
2. Expanded long-term repair options (jetting, CIPP lining, the honest line where a collapsed pipe needs replacement).
3. Internal links fixed: "trenchless repair" and "schedule a camera inspection" had pointed at the homepage; now real service, guide and city destinations.
4. Two new FAQs (cracked vs collapsed; lining after storm damage).
5. Freshness: updated modified date.

# Status
Reviewed and published via SSH/WP-CLI around Jul 20-21 with FAQPage JSON-LD (per the handoff). Note: the refresh mentions replacement or bursting for collapsed pipes; pipe bursting is not a Pipeliners service.
